author: Kevin Ertel
name: CollectHelper
description: Adds buttons to the Selected Images module that change the collection filter based on a selected image's folder or color labels, with an option to return to the previous collection.
description-extensive: This add-on gives you quick buttons that instantly filter your photo library to match a chosen photo. With one click you can show all pictures from the same folder or with the same color label, or jump back to your previous view. It is a handy shortcut for navigating large collections without setting up filters by hand. No extra software is required.
